reasons: hsm_kms: BLOCKED by interface implemented; a real HSM/KMS tenancy is a procurement action. pkg/platform/security/keys now has a SoftwareBacked production guard (RequireProductionSafe refuses any software-backed provider under env=production) and pkg/blockers/hsmkms proves every failure mode -- unavailable, timeout, permission-denied, wrong-key, revoked -- fails closed, with the revoked case proving the provider is never even touched -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

live_data: BLOCKED by requires commercial data contracts. pkg/blockers/livedata now has a real FeedConnector/Pipeline with content-hash dedup and a real anti-replay defense (every accepted record replayed back and confirmed rejected) across all four source types, and refuses any SIMULATED-mode connector's record tagged LIVE -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

multi_region_dr: BLOCKED by requires multi-region infrastructure. pkg/blockers/dr now models regions as real raftlite nodes connected through a real network-partition-capable transport, fails the leader region, measures real RTO/RPO, heals it, and confirms convergence -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). Still requires real cross-datacenter infrastructure to qualify real network behavior.

pentest: BLOCKED by requires an external security vendor; cannot be produced by any sandbox. pkg/blockers/pentest now runs a real target registry, a real release-identity preflight, and adversarial probes (JWT alg=none, unknown kid, sandbox path traversal, authz wildcard escalation) directly against this codebase's own production pkg/api/pkg/kernel/sandbox/pkg/authz -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). Still requires a real vendor's signed report through pkg/governance/qualification to ever reach VERIFIED.

scale_qualification: BLOCKED by requires physical multi-node infrastructure. pkg/blockers/scale now runs a real goroutine-based NodeProvider and a real exactly-once-delivery integrity check (with deliberate loss/duplication injection tests proving the check actually works) -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). A RealNodeProvider satisfying the same interface against 100 real nodes is a provider swap, not a rewrite.

soak_72h: BLOCKED by the harness now exists and genuinely runs — see test/soak and evidence/soak-report.json (2188 real iterations over 90s in this session, 0 errors, goroutines flat at 2->2) — but this environment cannot honestly stay up for the required 72h continuous window; VERIQO_SOAK_MINUTES=4320 against the same unchanged test on a long-lived host produces the qualifying evidence. pkg/blockers/soak now formalizes the same technique behind a Start/Checkpoint/Monitor/DetectLeak/DetectDrift/Finalize/GenerateEvidence API with a hash-chained, tamper-evident checkpoint sequence -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION on the machinery; the real 72h window is still unrun).

spire_mtls: BLOCKED by a real single-node SPIRE server+agent was run in this session — see evidence/spire_mtls-local-integration.txt — with genuine attestation, X.509-SVID issuance and revocation; still requires a multi-node cluster with a production node attestor and a Workload API client wired into pkg/transport/rafttcp, none of which this evidence covers. pkg/blockers/spiffe now qualifies the client-side validation logic with real X.509 chain verification and a full failure matrix (expired, revoked, untrusted CA, claimed-vs-actual identity mismatch) -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

supply_chain_scan: BLOCKED by staticcheck AND gosec both run clean (0 findings each) in a network-enabled session — see evidence/supply_chain_scan-gosec-full.txt; all 89 gosec findings across every severity were individually triaged and fixed or justified with a named reason, including catching and correcting a real bug in the prior round's own suppression comments. govulncheck's vulnerability feed (vuln.go.dev) returned 403, and so did osv.dev and the GitHub advisory API — tried as alternates — under this environment's network policy, so vulnerability-DB scanning specifically remains unqualified: SAST is fully closed, dependency-vulnerability scanning is not. pkg/blockers/supplychain now has a real `go list -m all` dependency-discovery step, a policy engine, and a real HTTP-backed VulnerabilityProvider (unit-tested against a local server since the real endpoints are network-blocked here) -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION on the pipeline; the vulnerability-DB query itself is still unqualified against a real feed).

gates.description: independent third-party penetration test
gates.exit_criteria: signed report from an external security vendor
gates.blocker: requires an external security vendor; cannot be produced by any sandbox. pkg/blockers/pentest now runs a real target registry, a real release-identity preflight, and adversarial probes (JWT alg=none, unknown kid, sandbox path traversal, authz wildcard escalation) directly against this codebase's own production pkg/api/pkg/kernel/sandbox/pkg/authz -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). Still requires a real vendor's signed report through pkg/governance/qualification to ever reach VERIFIED.

gates.description: 100-node / 1M-evidence physical benchmark
gates.exit_criteria: p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput at 100 nodes
gates.blocker: requires physical multi-node infrastructure. pkg/blockers/scale now runs a real goroutine-based NodeProvider and a real exactly-once-delivery integrity check (with deliberate loss/duplication injection tests proving the check actually works) -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). A RealNodeProvider satisfying the same interface against 100 real nodes is a provider swap, not a rewrite.

gates.description: multi-region deployment and DR drill with measured RPO/RTO
gates.exit_criteria: destroy primary, restore, verify ledgers and replay
gates.blocker: requires multi-region infrastructure. pkg/blockers/dr now models regions as real raftlite nodes connected through a real network-partition-capable transport, fails the leader region, measures real RTO/RPO, heals it, and confirms convergence -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION). Still requires real cross-datacenter infrastructure to qualify real network behavior.

gates.description: production HSM/KMS backed signing
gates.exit_criteria: KeyProvider backed by a real HSM or cloud KMS
gates.blocker: interface implemented; a real HSM/KMS tenancy is a procurement action. pkg/platform/security/keys now has a SoftwareBacked production guard (RequireProductionSafe refuses any software-backed provider under env=production) and pkg/blockers/hsmkms proves every failure mode -- unavailable, timeout, permission-denied, wrong-key, revoked -- fails closed, with the revoked case proving the provider is never even touched -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

gates.description: non-synthetic live data feeds (SWIFT/BoL/AIS/SAR)
gates.exit_criteria: ingest qualified against contracted live feeds
gates.blocker: requires commercial data contracts. pkg/blockers/livedata now has a real FeedConnector/Pipeline with content-hash dedup and a real anti-replay defense (every accepted record replayed back and confirmed rejected) across all four source types, and refuses any SIMULATED-mode connector's record tagged LIVE -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

gates.description: 72-hour continuous soak with zero leak and zero ledger corruption
gates.exit_criteria: 72h run with stable memory, goroutines and ledger integrity
gates.blocker: the harness now exists and genuinely runs — see test/soak and evidence/soak-report.json (2188 real iterations over 90s in this session, 0 errors, goroutines flat at 2->2) — but this environment cannot honestly stay up for the required 72h continuous window; VERIQO_SOAK_MINUTES=4320 against the same unchanged test on a long-lived host produces the qualifying evidence. pkg/blockers/soak now formalizes the same technique behind a Start/Checkpoint/Monitor/DetectLeak/DetectDrift/Finalize/GenerateEvidence API with a hash-chained, tamper-evident checkpoint sequence -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION on the machinery; the real 72h window is still unrun).

gates.description: real SPIRE deployment with workload attestation and mTLS rotation
gates.exit_criteria: node A and node B attest, rotate and revoke identities
gates.blocker: a real single-node SPIRE server+agent was run in this session — see evidence/spire_mtls-local-integration.txt — with genuine attestation, X.509-SVID issuance and revocation; still requires a multi-node cluster with a production node attestor and a Workload API client wired into pkg/transport/rafttcp, none of which this evidence covers. pkg/blockers/spiffe now qualifies the client-side validation logic with real X.509 chain verification and a full failure matrix (expired, revoked, untrusted CA, claimed-vs-actual identity mismatch) -- see evidence/blockers-qualification-report.json (READY_FOR_REAL_QUALIFICATION).

gates.exit_criteria: all scanners run and report clean
